parsed.post: Attempted to increase DEPTH to 8, but val_bpb regressed to 1.003346 from 1.002109. The increased parameter count likely slowed down the number of gradient updates possible within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to DEPTH=6. Next, I will experiment with optimizing ASPECT_RATIO to see if we can improve throughput/capacity balance.
parsed.description: Revert depth to 6 after regression and increase ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to optimize throughput/expressivity balance.
